about: The content revisions a site build serves. Step 4.1 of buildScripts/updateNeoVersion.mjs fetches github-content-sync (corpus) and every learnSpokes repository at its exact 40-hex commit SHA — never a branch head — materializing only docs/public-manifest.json-admitted guides before Step 7 rebuilds indexes, sitemaps, and llms*.txt. Publish cadence: spoke guide edits reach neomjs.com by bumping the spoke's 40-hex commit pin here and running npm run update-neo-version-force (or on the next Engine release cut).
